How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad have restrictive policies that exclude creators from certain countries. This exclusion can be devastating for digital creators who rely on these platforms to sell their products. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, provides a permanent structural alternative that operates at the base layer, allowing creators to own and control their digital commerce stacks, regardless of their geographical location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the significant advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is that it provides creators with full ownership and control over their digital products and sales data. This ownership enables automation and instant delivery of digital products, reducing the need for intermediaries and minimizing the risk of account suspension or fund holdouts. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can focus on producing high-quality content and building their brand, rather than worrying about payment processing and delivery.
